text:
Asha: Heads-up 2: QuickFuse (partner) greenlit a joint marketplace listing + integration webinar. We need: blog + benchmark angle, webinar format & date, co-branded assets, and lead routing. Volunteers?

Diego: Ill take the webinar ops (registration, slides, recording). Suggest Wed Nov 12 10am PT. Anyone blocked?

Renee: Fine for date. For the blog we should decide on a single benchmark narrative 

Noah: Eng-ML chiming in  I can run a small benchmark matrix: p50/p95, tokens/sec under batching at 512/2048 contexts, and cost estimate across our recommended quantization. Need the model name QuickFuse is deploying.

Clara: Partner asked for a co-branded one-pager and a short demo script. Also QuickFuse wants their PM (Tomas) to provide a customer quote.

Evan: For inbound leads, propose creating SFDC campaign "QF-Marketplace-Nov2026". Route marketplace form fills first to partner-queue for 24-72h, then to AE. We should flag high-intent leads (intent>=70) for immediate AE outreach.

Asha: Nice. Evan can you draft the routing steps & required fields? Diego will confirm webinar landing form fields (email, company, role, use case).

Diego: Landing form will have email, company, role, region, and an optional "integration interest" checkbox. Will add utm parameters.

Renee: Draft headline ideas: 1) "QuickFuse + Redwood: Cut inference spend, keep latency tight" 2) "Benchmark: Serving QuickFuse with sub-120ms p95 at production load" 3) "How QuickFuse scales embeddings for search using Redwood"  Noah, can you sign off on any claims?

Noah: I can validate. Note: sub-120ms p95 depends on sequence length and batching policies. Prefer: "~120ms p95 on 64-256 token prompts at production batching" for safe copy.

PartnerBot: QuickFuse partner updated assets uploaded to #partner-assets. Speaker Tomas confirmed. (automated)

Clara: Tomas will send a short quote and a logo pack by Friday. Also asked for co-hosting rights to record and republish the webinar.

Asha: Webinar format: 25min demo (Clara + Tomas) showing integration flow, 15min benchmark walk-through (Noah), 20min live Q&A. Keep it under 60min.

Diego: Action list: Diego = webinar ops, Noah = benchmark numbers + single benchmark slide, Renee = blog draft & headline variants, Evan = SFDC campaign + routing doc, Clara = partner assets & speaker comms. Target assets ready by Nov 3 for review.

Renee: I'll spin up a blog outline in Drive and add suggested CTAs. Proposed CTA: "Try the QuickFuse integration" -> marketplace listing + demo request. UTM: utm_source=marketplace&utm_campaign=quickfuse_launch&utm_medium=partner

Noah: Send me example prompt lengths and a small sample of typical traffic bursts (10/50/90 percentile) so I can pick batching knobs.

Clara: Uploading traffic sample and demo prompts to the shared drive now.

Asha: Great progress. Please flag blockers by EOD Tuesday. Will compile a one-pager for comms and partner ops after the review. :white_check_mark:

Diego: Calendar hold created for Nov 12.

Evan: Routing doc draft shared: https://drive.redwood/qf-marketplace-routing. Includes SLA windows and nurture cadence.

Renee: Blog outline: https://drive.redwood/qf-integration-blog-draft  comments welcome.

Clara: Partner quote incoming from Tomas.

Noah: Will run benchmarks and post numbers by Nov 1.

Asha: Thanks team  Ill send the consolidated one-pager tomorrow morning.
